description: This file implements socket-related functions and a Socket class for network communication, including address handling, socket creation, connection, binding, listening, accepting, and configuration options, along with an output stream operator for socket addresses.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: A wrapper class for socket operations, providing methods for connection, binding, listening, accepting, and configuration, encapsulating the underlying socket handle.

methods.name: GetUnspecifiedAddress
methods.description: Returns an address with the specified type and port, with address fields initialized to zero.

methods.name: GetLocalhostAddress
methods.description: Initializes an address as localhost (127.0.0.1 for IPv4 or ::1 for IPv6) based on the address type and port.

methods.name: Socket constructor
methods.description: Constructs a socket with specified address type and protocol, or defaults to IPv4 TCP.

methods.name: Socket destructor
methods.description: Destroys the socket handle.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the socket handle is valid.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Puts the socket into listening mode.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, returning a new Socket object if successful.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: IsPending
methods.description: Checks if the last socket error indicates a pending operation.

methods.name: GetLastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last socket error.

methods.name: ClearLastError
methods.description: Clears the last socket error.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket, storing the source address.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specified destination address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: SetBroadcast
methods.description: Enables or disables broadcast on the socket.

methods.name: SetReuseAddress
methods.description: Enables or disables address reuse.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the receive buffer.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the send buffer.

methods.name: SetTcpKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive with a specified period.

methods.name: SetTcpNoDelay
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP no-delay (Nagle's algorithm).

methods.name: SetTcpWindowScaling
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP window scaling.

methods.name: JoinMulticastGroup
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.
